Sophisticated Backpacks - Digital Storages Expansion

Connect your backpack to digital storage networks. Carry less. Do more.

Remote Deposit

Send matching backpack items to your linked storage network.

  • Deposit with a button in the upgrade tab.
  • Filter which items leave your backpack.

Remote Restock

Bring supplies from your linked network into your backpack.

  • Restock with a button in the upgrade tab.
  • Choose which supplies to retrieve.

Remote Pickup

Send matching items to storage as you pick them up.

  • Choose network or backpack priority.
  • Keep unwanted items out with filters.

Remote Magnet

Gather nearby drops and send them to your preferred destination.

  • Collect nearby matching item drops.
  • Choose network or backpack priority.

Remote Refill

Keep selected inventory slots stocked while you build or explore.

  • Choose what to keep on hand.
  • Set your preferred supply source.

Remote Feeding

Stay fed with food from your backpack or linked network.

  • Filter which foods can be used.
  • Configure hunger and injury conditions.

Remote Alchemy

Use configured consumables automatically when you need them.

  • Choose consumables and trigger conditions.
  • Set network or backpack priority.

Remote Pump

Move fluids between your linked network, backpack tank and the world.

  • Filter fluids and configure transfer settings.
  • Tom’s Storage supports items only.

Remote Crafting

Fill your crafting grid with ingredients from your backpack and network.

  • Fetch missing ingredients for a chosen recipe.
  • Use backpack controls or JEI recipe transfer.

Link your upgrade

Hold a Remote Upgrade and Shift-right-click a compatible endpoint to link it. Most other blocks on the same network can also be used for linking.
